# Excellence in Periodontics and Dental Implant Surgery - Richmond & Midlothian, VA

### Drs. Ben Overstreet, John White, Kara Dunegan, and Denver Lyons are Board Certified Periodontists

We are a practice devoted to the specialty of _Periodontics and Dental Implant Surgery._

In our periodontal dental practice, our focus is on the patient’s overall health, as new research has linked periodontal (gum) disease to cardiovascular disease, diabetes, respiratory infection, and possibly stroke. We provide many surgical services including dental implant surgery or dental implant placement. The doctors are members of the American Dental Association, the American Academy of Periodontology, the Academy of Osseointegration, the American Board of Periodontology, the Southern Academy of Periodontology, the Virginia Society of Periodontology, and the Richmond Dental Society. All doctors have been nominated as Top Periodontists as voted on by their peers in Richmond Magazine. We are excited about the opportunity to provide your periodontal care and work closely with your general dentist to create a healthy foundation for your smile.

Make an appointment today... .we’ll give you a reason to smile!

## Drs. Overstreet, White & Dunegan, Ltd.

## Testimonials

#### My mom was referred to Dr. White for a biopsy of her lip. He did a great job and was both caring and professional. The front office staff went above and beyond to provide the necessary information to the Mohs surgeon she needed to see. Who nowadays calls to resolve a document issue with a surgeon's office and actually follows up with an update? This office does. Highly recommend! Their patients truly come first.

Kathy O.

#### Dr. Overstreet is, hands down, the best doctor of any kind I have ever had the experience of visiting. He actually cares about his patients, and that comes through in everything he does. I am deathly, freakishly afraid of dentists of any sort, and I didn't even have to take my xanax to go see Dr. Overstreet. I wish I was kidding, but I am not. I wish he did all kinds of doctoring so I would never have to go see any other doctor, ever.

T.W.

#### My experience has been top notch throughout the entire process, not to mention that I've never been more confident and proud of my smile. I can feel myself smiling bigger, brighter and more often since my procedure. This has been the best surgical decision I've ever made! Thank you Dr. Overstreet and team!

Makenzie B.
